Senior Cloud Architect — Outside IR35 Contract
Location: Remote (occasional travel to Manchester office)
Rate: £700–£800 per day
Duration: 12 months
IR35 Status: Outside IR35

Role Overview:
A leading financial services firm is seeking a Senior Cloud Architect to lead the design and delivery of a greenfield AWS-native platform. This role sits within the Cloud Centre of Excellence and requires hands-on delivery alongside strategic thinking.

Responsibilities:
- Architect scalable, secure AWS solutions following the AWS Well-Architected Framework
- Lead cloud security design: IAM, VPC design, encryption at rest/transit, GuardDuty, SecurityHub
- Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and AWS CodePipeline
- Define cost optimisation strategies: Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, right-sizing
- Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform and AWS CDK
- Design data streaming architectures using Apache Kafka and AWS Kinesis
- Work with data engineering teams on Databricks and Snowflake integration patterns
- Create and maintain architecture documentation: C4 diagrams, ADRs, solution design documents
- Lead AWS migration assessments and cloud adoption framework reviews

Essential Skills:
- Expert-level AWS (5+ years): EC2, S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, CloudFront
- Terraform (3+ years) — production-grade modules, state management, workspaces
- Cloud security — CIS benchmarks, NIST, PCI-DSS compliance patterns
- Microservices and container orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS)
- API design and management: REST, GraphQL, AWS API Gateway
- DevSecOps: SAST/DAST integration, container scanning, secrets management (Vault/Secrets Manager)

Desirable:
- AWS certifications (SAP-C02, SCS-C02, ANS-C01)
- MLOps experience: SageMaker, ML pipelines, model serving
- FinTech or banking sector experience
- Apache Kafka or AWS Kinesis streaming architecture

The Environment:
You will join a team of 8 cloud architects working within a programme delivering core banking modernisation. Collaborative, technically rigorous, outcomes-focused.
